Mandate Desk

AI agents now pay on people's behalf. Before each payment, this desk checks who built the agent, who it works for, and what that person actually authorized. It also watches for abuse that only shows up across many payments.

All operators, principals, agents, wallets and payments are synthetic. The screening list stands in for a real sanctions list such as OFAC's. Credentials and approvals are real Ed25519 signatures, verified when the data was built. KYA isn't required by name anywhere yet (as of November 2026). It extends existing KYC, KYB and AML duties to the software acting for a customer.
